description: This file contains the embedded source code and initialization logic for the DataTables jQuery plugin, configured for MDBootstrap integration. It includes version information, licensing, and the implementation of the DataTables API, with features such as pagination, filtering, sorting, column management, and browser detection.

classes.name: DataTable
classes.description: Constructor function for initializing DataTables instances with options, handling DOM setup, and managing table features.

classes.name: DataTable.Api
classes.description: API class used to control and interface with one or more DataTables instances, supporting chainable methods for data retrieval, manipulation, and table control.

methods.name: api
methods.description: Creates a DataTables API instance for chainable operations, with optional strict mode.

methods.name: rows
methods.description: Selects rows based on a selector or index, returning row data or API elements.

methods.name: column
methods.description: Accesses specific columns for manipulation or data retrieval.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Redraws the table, updating display based on current data.

methods.name: _fnFilterColumn
methods.description: Filters table rows based on a specific column, with options for regex, smart filtering, and case insensitivity.

methods.name: _fnFilter
methods.description: Performs table filtering based on user input and updates the display accordingly.

methods.name: _fnFilterCreateSearch
methods.description: Creates a RegExp object for filtering, supporting smart filtering and regex options.

methods.name: _fnEscapeRegex
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string for safe use in RegExp matches.

methods.name: _fnFilterData
methods.description: Updates the internal filter data for each row, decoding HTML entities and preparing filter strings.

methods.name: _fnSearchToCamel
methods.description: Converts internal Hungarian notation search parameters to camelCase for external interaction.

methods.name: _fnSearchToHung
methods.description: Converts camelCase search parameters back to internal Hungarian notation.

methods.name: _fnFeatureHtmlInfo
methods.description: Generates the DOM node for the table's information display element.

methods.name: _fnUpdateInfo
methods.description: Updates the content of the information display with current table status.

methods.name: _fnInfoMacros
methods.description: Replaces macros in the info string with current table metrics like start, end, total records.

methods.name: _fnInitialise
methods.description: Handles initial setup of the table, including building header/footer, calculating column widths, and starting Ajax data loads.

methods.name: _fnInitComplete
methods.description: Called upon table initialization completion to finalize setup and trigger callbacks.

methods.name: _fnLengthChange
methods.description: Changes the number of records displayed per page and redraws the table.

methods.name: _fnFeatureHtmlLength
methods.description: Creates the DOM node for the user interface controlling page length.

methods.name: _fnFeatureHtmlPaginate
methods.description: Creates the DOM node for pagination controls.

methods.name: _fnPageChange
methods.description: Changes the current page based on the specified action (first, previous, next, last, numeric) and updates display.

methods.name: _fnFeatureHtmlProcessing
methods.description: Creates the DOM node for the processing indicator.

methods.name: _fnProcessingDisplay
methods.description: Shows or hides the table's processing indicator.

methods.name: _fnFeatureHtmlTable
methods.description: Generates the table layout when scrolling is enabled, including header, body, and footer sections.

methods.name: _fnScrollDraw
methods.description: Adjusts header, footer, and body layout to handle resizing, scrollbars, and column alignment for scrolling tables.

methods.name: _fnCalculateColumnWidths
methods.description: Calculates and assigns column widths, accommodating user input, DOM measurements, and table resizing.

methods.name: _fnGetWidestNode
methods.description: Finds the widest cell node in a column to determine optimal column width.

methods.name: _fnGetMaxLenString
methods.description: Identifies the row with the maximum string length in a specific column, useful for width calculations.

methods.name: _fnStringToCss
methods.description: Converts numerical or dimension strings into valid CSS width values with units.

methods.name: _fnSortFlatten
methods.description: Flattens the sorting configuration array into a prioritized list of sort directives.

methods.name: _fnSort
methods.description: Performs multi-column sorting of table data based on current sorting configuration.

methods.name: _fnSortAria
methods.description: Updates ARIA attributes for columns based on current sorting state for accessibility.

methods.name: _fnSortListener
methods.description: Handles user clicks on column headers to trigger sorting, supporting multi-column sorting if enabled.

methods.name: _fnSortAttachListener
methods.description: Attaches event listeners to column headers for sorting interactions.

methods.name: _fnSortingClasses
methods.description: Applies CSS classes to indicate sorted columns for visual feedback.

methods.name: _fnSortData
methods.description: Prepares data for sorting by applying custom or default sort order formatters.

methods.name: _fnSaveState
methods.description: Stores current table state (pagination, sorting, filtering) for persistence.

methods.name: _fnLoadState
methods.description: Attempts to restore table state from saved data, respecting duration and custom options.

methods.name: _fnSettingsFromNode
methods.description: Retrieves the internal DataTables settings object associated with a specific table DOM node.

methods.name: _fnLog
methods.description: Logs warnings or errors, with optional callback or alert mechanism.

methods.name: _fnMap
methods.description: Copies a property from source to target object, optionally with mapping rules.

methods.name: _fnExtend
methods.description: Performs deep or shallow copy of objects, with special handling for arrays to avoid references.

methods.name: _fnBindAction
methods.description: Binds click and keypress actions to elements for accessible event handling.

methods.name: _fnCallbackReg
methods.description: Registers callback functions within DataTables' internal callback registry.

methods.name: _fnCallbackFire
methods.description: Executes registered callback functions and triggers custom events.

methods.name: _fnCallbackReg
methods.description: Registers a callback function in the table's settings object with an associated name.

methods.name: _fnCallbackFire
methods.description: Executes registered callback functions and triggers custom events associated with table operations.

methods.name: _fnLengthOverflow
methods.description: Adjusts display start index if it has gone beyond the available data and needs to be corrected.

methods.name: _fnRenderer
methods.description: Selects and returns the appropriate renderer function based on table settings and requested type.

methods.name: _fnDataSource
methods.description: Determines whether the data source for the table is server-side, Ajax, or DOM.

methods.name: DataTable.Api
methods.description: Constructor function for creating API instances to control DataTables; provides chainable methods for table operations.
